name: inventory-narrow-real
command: p=$(/bin/busybox pidof buildkitd); grep -E 'Cap|NoNewPrivs' /proc/$p/status; buildctl debug workers; zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E 'CONFIG_(BLK_DEV_LOOP|OVERLAY_FS)'; df -h /var/lib/buildkit

name: prune-native
command: set -eu; buildctl du; buildctl prune --all; buildctl du; df -h /var/lib/buildkit; sync

name: fixture
command:
set -eu; printf %s '#!/usr/bin/python3
import io,os,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("/tmp/fixture");p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(p/"busybox").write_bytes(Path("/bin/busybox").read_bytes());os.chmod(p/"busybox",0o755)
with tarfile.open(p/"fixture.tar","w",format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as t:
    for name,data,uid,gid,mode,xattrs in [
        ("owned",b"owner proof\n",123,456,0o751,{"SCHILY.xattr.user.phase6":"yes"}),
        ("sbin/probe-init",b"#!/bin/busybox sh\n/bin/busybox mount -t proc proc /proc\n/bin/busybox echo CONVERTED_ROOT_BOOTED\n/bin/busybox stat -c '\''%u:%g %a %h %n'\'' /owned /hard\n/bin/busybox readlink /sym\n/bin/busybox cat /dir/new\n/bin/busybox test ! -e /gone && /bin/busybox echo WHITEOUT_OK\n/bin/busybox cat /proc/mounts\n/bin/busybox poweroff -f\n",0,0,0o755,{})]:
        info=tarfile.TarInfo(name);info.uid=uid;info.gid=gid;info.mode=mode;info.size=len(data);info.pax_headers=xattrs
        t.addfile(info,io.BytesIO(data))
(p/"Dockerfile").write_text("""FROM scratch
COPY busybox /bin/busybox
ADD fixture.tar /
RUN ["/bin/busybox", "sh", "-c", "/bin/busybox ln /owned /hard; /bin/busybox ln -s /owned /sym; /bin/busybox echo old > /gone; /bin/busybox mkdir /dir; /bin/busybox echo old > /dir/old; /bin/busybox cat /proc/self/status"]
RUN ["/bin/busybox", "sh", "-c", "/bin/busybox rm /gone; /bin/busybox rm -rf /dir; /bin/busybox mkdir /dir; /bin/busybox echo newer > /dir/new"]
ENV PHASE6_VALUE=preserved
LABEL example.phase="6"
""")
' > /tmp/fixture.py; python3 /tmp/fixture.py; buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/tmp/fixture --local dockerfile=/tmp/fixture --output type=oci,dest=/var/lib/buildkit/trial/fixture,tar=false; python3 /usr/local/lib/frames.py emit /var/lib/buildkit/trial/fixture /tmp/fixture.frames; sync

name: without-sys-admin
command:
printf %s '#!/usr/bin/python3
import json,os,select,subprocess,time
cmd=["setpriv","--no-new-privs","--bounding-set=-sys_admin","buildkitd","--addr","unix:///run/no-admin.sock","--root","/var/lib/buildkit/no-admin","--oci-worker-snapshotter=native","--oci-worker-net=host","--containerd-worker=false","--oci-worker-gc=false"]
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
log=b""
try:
    deadline=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        ready,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],max(0,deadline-time.monotonic()))
        if not ready:raise TimeoutError("daemon readiness")
        b=os.read(p.stdout.fileno(),4096)
        if not b:raise RuntimeError(log.decode())
        log+=b
        if b"running server on" in log:break
    else:raise TimeoutError("daemon readiness")
    result=subprocess.run(["buildctl","--addr","unix:///run/no-admin.sock","build","--frontend","dockerfile.v0","--local","context=/tmp/fixture","--local","dockerfile=/tmp/fixture","--output","type=oci,dest=/tmp/no-admin.tar"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
    print(json.dumps({"build_returncode":result.returncode,"build_log":result.stdout+result.stderr,"daemon_log":log.decode()}))
finally:
    p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=10)
' > /tmp/privilege.py; python3 /tmp/privilege.py
